comments: Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pandus-accessibility-and/oplhpiaacmpenolhmejmoikdielfakjn . The check runs locally in the browser with axe-core (Deque Systems); nothing is sent anywhere unless the user saves the result to a Pandus account. It does not change the checked site. The overall Pandus service was submitted separately (pull request #1375).
features: Free extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox that checks the open page against WCAG 2.2 A and AA with axe-core, also behind a login (cart, checkout, staging). Outlines each element on the page, explains it in plain language in 7 languages, and adds manual-review aids: tab order and heading outline. Automated check, not a full audit.
title: Pandus browser extension
